params.prompt:
Create one NEW premium editorial photograph of DRIED produce, portrait 3:4 website category card. The supplied Fresh image is a structural/style anchor ONLY: use the true overhead camera, two side-by-side zones, strong central vertical divider, controlled density and restrained photographic realism. Create a distinctly preserved-food image with different materials, scale and arrangement. Do not copy individual fruit positions, harvest-crate geometry, fresh whole citrus or pomegranates.
Camera exactly 90 degrees straight down, sensor parallel to rims, no perspective tilt or convergence. Two adjacent shallow professional drying trays in restrained warm charcoal-brown, with broad smooth simple rims and finely perforated food-safe metal bases. A clear vertical center seam. Clean and refined export-quality presentation, no woodgrain rustic props, no surrounding market scene. Trays may extend past top and bottom frame edges; edge-to-edge portrait photograph with breathing room and readable simple organization.
LEFT ZONE: naturally dried orange wheels, with a smaller number of dried lemon slices. Thin irregular slices with subtly curled edges, translucent amber and muted ochre pulp, darker rind, visible dry citrus segment structure and natural variation in thickness and size. Loose small overlapping groups, not a perfect grid or decorative pattern. RIGHT ZONE: mostly whole dried dates, natural deep chestnut-brown wrinkled skin with restrained natural satin highlights, plus a small minority of whole dried figs with matte tan folded leathery surfaces and flattened forms, approximately four dates per fig. Dates and figs clearly distinct in shape and texture. No fresh fruit, no leaves, no extra products. Product occupies about 70–80 percent visual fill with dark surface gaps and clean rims; shallow layer, no overstuffing. Realistic relative product scale, independent varied shapes, no cloned items.
Warm-neutral soft directional daylight from upper-left, elegant gentle shadows lower-right, earthy restrained palette, tactile dryness and preserved-product richness without an orange cast. High-end photographic realism and natural detail, dry food surfaces, no syrup, wet shine, HDR, oversaturation or CGI. Preserve strong color/texture readability in a small category card. Keep important category cues inside central 75% safe area and ordinary continuation at the lower title-overlap zone. Pure photograph, no caption panel.
EXCLUDE all text, letters, numbers, typography, logos, labels, stickers, watermarks, branding, packaging, paper liners, bowls, props, hands, people, garnish, leaves, spice-market clutter, craft-market styling, fake rustic surfaces, symmetric arrangements, repeated patterns, fresh oranges, pomegranates or random extra foods.
